destruction-of-the-rebirth-wheel:
Scarlet King has lived and died more times than anyone could ever count.
Every death should have been an ending.
Instead, the Rebirth Wheel drags him back—into another body, another world, another life.
Again.
And again.
And again.
After countless cycles of existence, Scarlet King no longer seeks immortality, glory, love, or salvation.
He seeks only one thing:
Eternal rest.
But as long as the Rebirth Wheel continues to turn, even death cannot grant him freedom.
So Scarlet King chooses the only path left to him.
He will destroy the Wheel itself.
Through cultivation, slaughter, forbidden paths, and worlds governed by laws far beyond ordinary understanding, he will climb across the Eleven Dimensions and tear apart anything standing between him and his final death.
He is no hero.
He seeks no redemption.
And he will not hesitate simply because countless lives stand in his way.
If worlds must fall for the Rebirth Wheel to finally break, then worlds will fall.
Because after enduring existence for longer than anyone should...
Scarlet King believes eternal rest is worth any price.…

oops-i-accidentally-fell-in-love-with-my:
I came home from college expecting to deal with my emotionally unavailable father, an empty fridge, and a summer full of boredom.
What I didn’t expect was to walk into the kitchen and find a barefoot, stunning woman in my dad’s shirt stirring eggs like she owned the place.
Spoiler: She does.
Her name is Elena, and apparently, she’s my brand-new stepmother—seven years older than me, way too cheerful, and totally off-limits.
But try telling that to my brain when she’s bending over to grab orange juice or accidentally falling on top of me in the laundry room. Try telling that to my heart when she’s laughing at my jokes, defending me at dinner, or wearing my hoodie because “it smells like comfort.”
My dad doesn’t see her. Not really.
But I do.
And that’s the problem.
Now I’m stuck in a house full of tension, sarcasm, and slow-burn chaos.
She’s married to my father.
I’m supposed to be focusing on my future.
But somehow, I’m falling for the one woman I absolutely, definitely, 100% should not be falling for.
Oops.

With multiple attempts on different timelines, The Do-Over System makes her choose one and that will be her final attempt and the Do-Over System will self-destruct permanently leaving her in the current timeline.…
the-extreme-alchemist-of-the-mighty-caul:
In a freak alchemy accident, the omnipotent Extreme Alchemist of his generation was bound to the continuous cycle of worldly existence. His fallen soul was reincarnated into the body of an ordinary young man named Fang Lin.
From then on, Fang Lin became the chaotic mess of an alchemy genius.
“You’re nothing but scraps before me. I am the almighty Extreme Alchemist! So, you’re a martial arts genius, huh? Come…Come. Come! Have a taste of the elixir made by the great master.”
The path of becoming an extreme alchemist was rough, bumpy and rugged, but at the end, the Mighty Cauldron awaited beyond the Nine Cauldrons!
the-lucky-star-reincarnates-to-bring-her:
Zhou Xiaoli, a carp living in Immortal Tai Yi’s lotus pond, transmigrated into a novel world and though she was supposed to be the female lead of it, another soul beat her to it!
After wandering as a ghost for 10 years in the novel world, she transmigrated into another body! Deemed a jinx, her grandparents disowned her and her family. Determined to build a better life for her family, she got to work! Soon, people in the village noticed that the Zhou family started having a lucky streak, and life could not be better!
Zhou Xiaoli’s father was no longer a fool, her mother was cured of her sickness while her siblings were all smart and resourceful. Zhou Xiaoli herself led the family as they cleared land in the wilderness, planted tea leaves and fruit trees, and started businesses… Life was beautiful.
That was when war struck, and the family was forced to leave and became refugees. Zhou Xiaoli: Don’t worry. I have a pocket dimension!
the-mafia-kings-hacker-bride:
“You really think you can just hide forever? From them? From me?”
“Do you really think we can be together?” she whispered, her voice rougher than she meant. “No. We can't. It just won't work.”
Zayden tilted his head, his thumb brushing against the frantic pulse under her jaw. “Why?” His voice dropped low, dangerously smooth. “Why can't we make this work, huh?”
She swallowed, the movement making her throat press harder against his hand. “Don't forget, You're----”
“Say you love me…. Or I’ll fvck that stubbornness right out of you. Bend you over this desk, and make you scream my name until you forget your own.”
Aylin's face turned beet red. She pushed against his chest forcefully. He didn't move an inch.
*****
Aylin Monroe Alston is a brilliant hacker and martial artist with Turkish roots. She can change her identity and her looks as easily as changing clothes. Always staying a step ahead of death, she had been on the run until she crashed into him.
Zayden Cole Virelli is a billionaire leading a double life. On one side, he is a successful businessman; on the other, he is a powerful mafia king.…
the-princesss-inner-thoughts-were-overhe:
[Mind Reading + Pet of the Group + Transmigration into a Book + System + Pretending to be Weak to Strike Powerful Enemies + Cannon Fodder’s Counterattack]
Xiao Chuchu transmigrated with a palace scheming system and foreknowledge about the future into the early-passing cannon fodder princess in the book.
Her Father Emperor would be poisoned to death, her Mother Consort forced to die in burial with Father Emperor, her elder brother and entire maternal family – loyal officials – would meet cruel fates!
The Xiao Dynasty would soon be destroyed under the new Emperor’s hand.
[Mother Consort ah, you did not fight or snatch, yet still incurred the jealousy of the Imperial Noble Consort, who issued an order for you to be buried alive with Father Emperor!] [Elder brother ah, accomplished in both civil and military affairs, yet still viewed with suspicion by the new Emperor after Father Emperor’s death, plotted against and killed at the border pass.…
the-time-stop-breeding-uncle-wants-to-re:
I’ve become the time-stop breeding uncle from an erot*c game.
But the situation is completely f*cked up, so I saved the world first.
Before I knew it, people around me were praising me as a hero.
…..I don’t give a f*ck about being a hero, I just want to retire. f*ck.
the-villainess-is-my-cute-daughter:
Adrian Sterling woke up in the body of a trash noble who was just divorced, exiled to a barren wasteland, and left with a five year old daughter. The catch? He knows this world. It's the setting of his favorite novel, and his adorable new daughter, Aria, is destined to become the world's most terrifying, hated Villainess.
In the original story, Adrian abandoned her, sealing her dark fate. But not this time.
Armed with a ridiculously named [Villainess's Daddy System] and absolute authority over a mysterious Dungeon, Adrian has a new goal: Spoil his daughter rotten and turn his impoverished wasteland into the wealthiest, most overpowered empire the continent has ever seen.
Greedy nobles? Arrogant heroes? If anyone dares to make his little girl cry, they will have to face the wrath of a Dungeon Master who holds the world's economy and monsters, in the palm of his hand.
“Papa, the world hates me...”
“Then Papa will just buy the world and give it to you.”
the-witch-thought-i-am-a-demon-god:
This is a world ruled by law, where exotic objects from the heavens descend.
The law of every individual, of every country, governs the workings of the world. When these laws collide, they birth—
Darkness, war, witchcraft, flame, faith, heroes and evil, polities and churches, gods and deformities, fairytales and nightmares.
Why can a flint elicit the loyalty of three massive hounds?
How can a flame determine the rise and fall of a nation?
Why can a mirror discern the good and evil within a person's heart?
How can a farmer slay a dragon, and a destitute wanderer become a king in a single bound?
Ivita came to this world, he has been here, he has travelled, he has conquered, and in the end, he will transform his thoughts and insights into a new Law to rule this vast land.
transmigrated-as-the-pregnant-villainess:
Su Wan died after staying up all night cursing the tragic villainess in a dog-blood CEO novel.
When she opens her eyes again—she has transmigrated into that very villainess.
Pregnant. Framed for adultery. And moments away from being divorced by her cold, ruthless husband, Lu Tingxiao.
In the original story, Su Wan loses her child, dies in disgrace, and becomes cannon fodder for the white-lotus heroine, Su Yao.
But this Su Wan knows the plot. She knows every trap. Every betrayal. Every secret.
Including one no one knows—the child in her womb is the future heir of the Lu empire.
When the cruel CEO shoves a divorce agreement in front of her, Su Wan tears it apart.
If they want war—she'll give them war.
Face-slapping scheming relatives. Protecting her unborn baby. Winning back power. And rewriting her doomed fate.
But what Su Wan doesn't expect is for the cold man who once wanted her gone—to become obsessed. To refuse divorce. To pin her against the wall and whisper in a dark voice—
“You can run, Mrs. Lu… but you're carrying my heir.”
A marriage of hatred. A pregnancy no one expected. A villainess who refuses to die.…
transmigration-of-the-famous-cyber-star:
Liu Man transmigrated from thousands of years ago to the modern world. Before she transmigrated, she was completely broke.
After she transmigrated, she was still worried about her wealth.
And so, for her to survive, she decided to start earning money by becoming a cyber star: trading and selling products, recording daily activities with her kittens, and showing off bits of her skills.
One day she realized, that unconsciously, she had become one of the most famous celebrities.
wait-system-stop-helping-the-protagonist:
You’ve probably read countless novels where someone transmigrates into their favorite book...
Or where the world of the novel becomes reality.
Well, I was lucky enough to transmigrate into mine.
Better yet, I even got the classic System—a cheat powerful enough to help me survive.
...Or so I thought.
Then someone explain this to me.
**WHY IS MY SYSTEM HELLBENT ON HELPING THE PROTAGONIST!?**
**IS THIS EVEN MY SYSTEM!?**
System...
Did your GPS lock onto the wrong person?
— Ashton, our dear gullible genius (or so he claims).
Powerless, Ashton could only watch as the protagonist claimed every overpowered treasure in the newbie village, mastered skills that even late-game bosses would kill to possess, and somehow expanded his already four-member harem.
Now, with a System obsessed with preserving the original story, Ashton has only one job:
Keep the protagonist alive. Keep the plot on track. And somehow survive a world where fate is determined to make someone else the hero.
Can he do it against other transmigraters just like him?
Author here: A fun power progression and souls-like world story.
yarras-adventure-notes:
In the magical Yarran World, a group of extraordinary professionals ventured into dangerous places for knowledge, wealth, thrill, and honor, exploring secrets hidden in the depths of time. Coexisting with dangers, they were given a fitting name—adventurers.
With so many adventurers around, there would be a few oddballs, of course. Take for instance, the swordsman who used to be a thirsty hedonist and now spent his days looking for ways to put his life in danger; the knight who saw gold coins as his ultimate pursuit; the schizophrenic and overly curious priest, and the genius mage who was prone to zoning out and could not care of himself. What kind of strange stories would these kooky individuals create when they came together?
Alright, all the above are just nonsense. In truth, this is a casual story of an abnormal, unscrupulous middle-aged man and a few problematic girls undergoing self-therapy- I mean, seeking redemption.
You have been solemnly warned that this story is purely fictional. If there is any glaring similarity, you probably need self-therapy too.
you-dont-want-your-secret-to-be-revealed:
After transmigration, Lin Yue could hear a voice whispering in his ear every day, sharing all sorts of secrets with him.
Small matters like the thoughts of the girl next door, to great mysteries like the secrets of the heavens, the voice persisted daily, broadcasting randomly.
He originally wanted to live an unremarkable life, but in this world of Xianxia dynasties where mortals are considered as insignificant as weeds, the fate of an ordinary man without power is no longer in his own hands.
Thus, he had no choice but to stop being 'just a person'.
'Your Majesty the Empress, you wouldn't want your secret of treason to be revealed by others, right?'
